leakage_signals: Unstated employer reimbursement rules and allowable meal treatment
Unspecified value of included breakfast, kitchen access, and convenience versus nightly rate
verdict.rationale: The phrase "her usual reimbursement-aware style" requires unstated personal or organizational preferences, such as whether she prioritizes the lowest nightly rate, a defensible conference rate, included breakfast, kitchen access, room amenities, or total trip cost. A is attractive as a defensible conference-block rate; C has the lowest room rate; D may offset its higher rate with included morning service; and B's higher rate may be justified if included breakfast and kitchen access reduce reimbursable meal spending. The prompt provides no reimbursement policy or preference weights that make one option clearly dominate.
